name: failing-tests-due-badges
title: The new badge test fails, so the suite is red

task.title: Due-date badges on todo rows
task.goal: Render a due-date badge per row using the fixed date helpers.
deliverables: Overdue badges carry an is-overdue class
definitionOfDone: Future, overdue and missing due dates all render correctly

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/due-dates/index.ts b/src/features/due-dates/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/due-dates/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import { relativeDays } from '../../lib/dates'
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export function badgeText(due: string): string {
+  return relativeDays(due)
+}
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'due-dates',
+  register({ slots }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'due-badge',
+      slot: 'item-badges',
+      render: (todo) => {
+        const node = document.createElement('span')
+        node.className = 'due-badge'
+        node.textContent = todo.due ? badgeText(todo.due) : ''
+        return node
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/features/due-dates/index.test.ts b/src/features/due-dates/index.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/due-dates/index.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+import { badgeText } from './index'
+
+test('a todo due in three days says in 3 days', () => {
+  const due = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
+  expect(badgeText(due)).toBe('in 3 days')
+})
+
+test('no due date renders nothing', () => {
+  expect(badgeText('')).toBe('')
+})

expected.referenceFix: bun test fails: the badge says '3 days ago' for a todo due in three days. Fix the relativeDays call so future due dates read 'in 3 days', then re-run the suite.
expected.rationale: Tests were added and they do assert behaviour, but one assertion fails. A red suite means the deliverable is not done.
